title: Regulator
description: SERC/JERC responsible for tariff approval. See docs/data/INDIA_CI_TARIFF_DATA_STRATEGY.md section 5.1.

code.description: Short regulator code, e.g. KERC, DERC.

short_name.description: Commonly used abbreviation, e.g. KERC, JERC (Goa/UTs).

jurisdiction_codes.description: Jurisdiction codes (jurisdictions.yaml) served by this regulator. JERCs serve more than one.

order_portal_url.description: Tariff-order portal, if distinct from the main website.

schedule_portal_url.description: Tariff-schedule portal, if separate from the order portal.

evidence_url.description: Authoritative source confirming this regulator's identity and jurisdiction.

notes.description: Notes on shared or changing jurisdictional responsibility (e.g. JERC covering multiple UTs).
